native_client: Google Cloud Console / BigQuery Studio; version not exposed
source_state_at_execution: Uncommitted source bytes, subsequently committed unchanged at source_revision; bound by exact hashes and provider SQL hashes.
scope: One 20210101 public GA4 shard, purchase events plus all same-day events for those pseudo-users; not full-day population or uncensored complete sessions.

metadata_query.observation: Completed job information UI; only data-job metadata was queried independently.

resources: Only managed temporary query results and job history; no persistent dataset, table, bucket, billing or IAM changes.

settings.note: Pre-execution UI estimates inspected. Native per-job bytes/timeout configuration was not verified; no configured limits are claimed. Both data jobs actually processed less than 100MB and were uncached.

rowset_comparison.method: SHA-256 of sorted per-row SHA-256 values, retaining repeated rows and nulls, plus row count. Opaque snapshot event keys excluded; item comparison includes parent event fields.
rowset_comparison.key_limitation: Content hash plus occurrence ordinal preserves repeats within one snapshot; not canonical identity or correction tracking across re-exports.
rowset_comparison.monetary_basis: Provider-normalized *_in_usd fields, rounded to integer cents per unit; no custom FX model.
rowset_comparison.capture: Normalized values read from rendered provider JSON results, not fabricated SDK responses.
